channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Writers grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new Writers grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    https://rorypecktrust.org/get-help/crisis/crisis-fund/
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Writers grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new Writers grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 10 Aug 2026 (10 Aug to 16 Aug 2026).

  • Alfred P. Sloan Foundation: Book Grants (Public Understanding of Science and Technology)
    https://sloan.org/programs/public-understanding/books
    Alfred P. Sloan Foundation · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Typically up to $60,000 per book grant
  • Printed Matter Publisher Work Grant 2026
    https://www.printedmatter.org/workgrant
    Printed Matter · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Three unrestricted grants of $10,000 USD each, plus a featured exhibitor presence (complimentary table) at a forthcoming Printed Matter NY or LA Art Book Fair. No application fee.

    https://appelsaprojets.francophonie.org/fr/applications/soutien-a-la-circulation-des-biens-et-mobilite-des-artistes
    Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to EUR 5,000 for artist mobility (travel, accommodation, visas, logistics). Up to EUR 2,500 for circulation of cultural goods (excess baggage, freight, customs). Both can be combined. No application fee.
